task_utility.claim: Mean test delta -0.00033063178121005494; 2/5 positive. Declared promotion gate fails; bounded screen remains inconclusive.

primary_explanation.statement: Observed failure is unstable held-out utility: validation improvement does not consistently carry to test. This is descriptive, not a proven cause.

alternative_explanations.statement: Short warmup/short intervention on a reused small subset may leave a weak or unstable representation; undertraining is untested without learning curves/warmup outputs.
Null mass could attenuate useful value context or the set measurement could miss relevant evidence; private fixed traces are needed to distinguish these mechanisms.

discriminating_measurement.uncertainty: Generalization/representation limitations versus an ineffective allocation or null mechanism.
discriminating_measurement.measurement: Read the existing immutable warmup metrics and predeclared matched sample traces; summarize null/token mass, attention/context/logit changes and first-update gradient norms, without retraining or selecting samples by outcome.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: No consistently useful held-out context shift despite nonzero finite changes; no scientific promotion.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: Concrete trace defect or excessive null suppression is localized; a separately reviewed and authorized correction can then be designed.

positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Engineering integrity is not proof of attention alignment, natural task utility or quantum advantage.

Existing-artifact diagnosis is the next recommendation, not a new experiment.
